title: Ergotropy from Geometric Phases in a Dephasing Qubit
summary: We analyze the geometric phase and dynamic phase acquired by a qubit coupled to an environment through pure dephasing, establishing a direct connection between phase accumulation and ergotropy. We show that the dynamic phase depends solely on the incoherent ergotropy, reflecting its purely energetic origin. In contrast, the geometric phase exhibits a nontrivial dependence on both the coherent and incoherent contributions to the total ergotropy, encoding the interplay between coherence, dissipation, and energy extraction.
